scientific_choices.rationale: Paper sections3.2-3.3 specify ResNet50/attention segmentation and component crop localization; additional heads and ablations below are separately classified.
Reuse selected research-v1 Text+Kernel control epoch2 and existing word_guided_contours kernel merging; preserve all historical masks, weights, source contracts and outputs.

Use saved native sigmoid384 text probabilities, bilinearly resize predicted256 kernel with align_corners=False; regenerate384 targets/validity/owners/canvas from qualified original data. Match boxes on unchanged original RGB. Spatial refinement distances scale with384/256, rounded upward only for its integer distance.

Preserve all high-threshold word IDs and expand by existing minimax watershed on text>=.5 within3 canonical pixels. Only seed-reachable support grows. This is a new postprocessing ablation, not PSENet reproduction.

Freeze near-kernel maximum threshold.35 before evaluation. Seeded-only is an explicit recall-sacrificing diagnostic control; neither filter changes the underlying network maps or applies an area/top10 cap.
Recognize all983 original GT bbox crops separately to diagnose failures. GT crops never enter prediction recipes or select thresholds; this oracle is not achieved detector performance.

CPU FP32/PARSeq batch8, deterministic settings, two threads, no segmentation rerun. All reference crop OCR executes afresh on CPU; only other exact RGB crop hashes reuse qualified prior caches with16-crop replay.
Single-seed, repeatedly reused TRAIN holdout125/983. No TEST selection, strict Table5 claim, additional training or GPU qualification.
